item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03595","case1_error":"Uses 12 birds per snake instead of the stated 3, confusing beetle consumption with bird consumption.","case2_error":"Treats the exceptional parrot as having four total claws and subtracts four instead of adding one extra claw.","reason":"The first substitutes the wrong consumption rate; the second mishandles the exceptional animal’s contribution to an otherwise correct total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03596","case1_error":"Models five children and five adults instead of three children and two adults.","case2_error":"Replaces the correctly calculated $5,700 goal with funds raised plus miscellaneous expenses, producing an incorrect shortfall.","reason":"Incorrect category multiplicities cause the first error; redefining the funding goal using receipts causes the second.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03597","case1_error":"Substitutes one Monday count for Tuesday’s two tile counts; the wording also leaves counting sessions versus individual objects ambiguous.","case2_error":"Divides revenue remaining after wages by ten instead of dividing the wage allocation by ten.","reason":"The second clearly answers the wrong quantity. The first includes an incorrect day substitution, but ambiguity about the requested counting unit makes comparison uncertain.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J03598","case1_error":"Adds all three inches of growth to the probability baseline defined at 66 inches, although Devin starts at 65 inches.","case2_error":"Changes Uber costing $3 more than Lyft into Lyft costing $4 more than Uber.","reason":"The first applies an increment from the wrong baseline; the second reverses a stated comparison and changes its amount. Both derivations contain explicit errors.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03599","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from rim height despite needing to reach six inches above it.","case2_error":"Calculates only the detour’s two hours and reports that as the entire trip duration, omitting the normal three hours.","reason":"The first reverses the direction of a height offset; the second reports an additional duration instead of the requested total duration.","judgment":"different"}]}
